title: CulturalCrosswords: A Multilingual Benchmark of Answer Constraints and Grid Completion
abstract: arXiv:2611.10044v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When several answers fit a riddle, exact-match scoring can penalise a valid response. CulturalCrosswords tests how answer constraints affect large language models (LLMs) solving cultural riddles, whose solutions draw on knowledge specific to a community. We constructed 53 crosswords from crowdsourced riddles in 42 languages and evaluated 11 LLM configurations on five versions of each clue set: plain batches, batches with lengths, batches with lengths and partial-answer hints, and crosswords requesting an answer list or a completed grid. On 962 clues with alternative answers, lengths improve agreement with the reference by 22.8 percentage points, compared with 8.4 points when accepted alternatives also receive credit. Part of the gain therefore appears to come from selecting a required answer form. translated_title: CulturalCrosswords：答案约束与网格填写的多语言基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.10044v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：当一个谜语有多个符合条件的答案时，精确匹配的评分方式可能会误判有效的回答。CulturalCrosswords 测试答案约束如何影响大型语言模型（LLM）解决文化谜题的能力，这类谜题的答案依赖于特定社区的知识。我们从42种语言的众包谜题中构建了53个填字游戏，并在每个线索集的五个版本上评估了11种LLM配置：普通批次、带长度信息的批次、带长度和部分答案提示的批次，以及要求提供答案列表或完成整个网格的填字游戏形式。在962个存在备选答案的线索上，长度信息使模型与参考答案的一致性提高了22.8个百分点，而当备选答案也计为正确时仅提高8.4个百分点。因此，部分收益似乎来自模型选择了所需的答案形式。填字游戏形式的输入使所有交叉点答案兼容的比例提高了9.7个百分点；而要求完成整个网格则揭示了显著的……
tldr: 该论文构建了覆盖42种语言、53个填字游戏的多语言基准CulturalCrosswords，发现长度提示和网格约束等答案约束能显著提升大型语言模型解答文化谜题时答案的准确性与一致性。
en_tdlr: CulturalCrosswords introduces a multilingual benchmark of 53 crosswords in 42 languages, showing that answer constraints such as length hints and grid completion substantially improve LLMs' agreement and accuracy in solving culturally grounded riddles.
